annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación; Ministerio de las TIC (Colombia)
key_provisions_or_claims: Risk-based classification of AI systems modelled on the EU AI Act
Governance framework and institutional bodies for AI oversight
Incentives for AI research, innovation and ecosystem strengthening
Labor transformation, training and social appropriation of AI knowledge
Procedure, sanctions and responsibilities to safeguard fundamental rights
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Colombian government bill, filed in the Senate on 7 May 2025, regulating AI for ethical and responsible development. It sets a risk-based classification modelled on the EU AI Act, governance bodies, innovation and research incentives, labor and training measures, and sanctions to protect fundamental rights. Robotic surgery and autonomous vehicles are mentioned only in passing.
annotation.title_clean: Proyecto de Ley "Por medio del cual se regula la inteligencia artificial en Colombia para garantizar su desarrollo ético y responsable y se dictan otras disposiciones"
annotation.title_en: Bill regulating artificial intelligence in Colombia to guarantee its ethical and responsible development, and other provisions
annotation.venue: Senado de la República de Colombia
